howto: Tap the tractor to earn coins.
Buy farm buildings: each one earns coins every second, even while you are away.
At 1M coins earned, start a New Farm+ for Legacy Points that raise all income by 10% each.
tips: Tap quickly for a combo: fast taps pay extra.
25 taps charge a Golden Harvest: +25% income for 10 seconds.
Fill the market orders for a big coin bonus before their timer runs out.
Catch the butterflies that flutter past for a reward.
Use the ×10 and ×25 buttons to buy buildings in bulk.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a button and press Enter or Space. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap the tractor and the buy buttons

difficulty: An idle curve: each building costs more than the last, owning 25, 50 and 100 of one multiplies its income, and every New Farm+ restarts the farm with more income per building.

cheats.effect: Hay rain: a big pile of coins (ten minutes' worth, at least 10,000)
Golden hour: a Golden Harvest that lasts a whole minute
Bumper crop: every tractor tap is worth 10 times more

features.offline-earnings: Welcome back card: coins the farm earned while away at half rate, up to 8 hours
features.upgrade-tree: Ten buildings from Wheat Field to Mega Farm with income milestones, plus the Farm Market and achievements
features.prestige-or-next-goal: New Farm+ for Legacy Points (+10% income each), and timed market orders as the next goal
features.tutorial: Coach cards on the first visit: tap, buy and prestige; replay with Learn to play
features.results: New Farm+ card with coins earned, Legacy Points and the new income multiplier
